id: title:Gilbert09:flag already connected sources in the catalog

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse source ingestion and connection state management
review.reason: The change implements a bounded, substantive improvement to the warehouse ingestion workflow. P1.F2.H5 and P1.F2.H6 establish the backend and frontend mechanisms to detect and display warehouse connection status, while P1.F2.H8 shifts the source of truth for this status from an API response field to a client-side set, improving reliability against inconsistent API responses. This,
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit of this change depends on the reliability and consistency of the API response field it replaces; while the code demonstrates a more robust approach, the complete absence of API dependency is not independently verified. No production incident or adoption metrics are available. No tier assignment requested.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No tier assignment requested.

observations.behavior: Adds a UI tag and tooltip to indicate a warehouse source type is already connected, and the backend logic to detect this and populate the catalog.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows warehouse source selection to distinguish between already-connected and new-source types, preventing redundant OAuth or table-prefix prompts.

observations.behavior: Adds a new action and listener to load warehouse sources, and a mount-time guard to trigger loading if not already done.
observations.posthog_connection: Ensures warehouse sources are fetched when the source catalog is opened, supporting the detection of existing connections.

observations.behavior: Changes the source of truth for detecting existing connections from an API response field to a client-side set of connected source types.
observations.posthog_connection: Implements the detection of already-connected warehouse sources without relying on potentially missing or inconsistent API response fields.
